appIcon.intent: White tile and more conspicuous restrained blue parrot
appIcon.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production macOS Parrot app icon.
Input image 1 is the sole EDIT TARGET. Preserve this exact established half-body parrot identity and layout. Change only the tile/background color and the existing bird fill.
Replace the warm stone-gray rounded-square tile with a clean opaque pure WHITE #FFFFFF tile, flat and smooth, with no gray/beige tint, mottled texture, stone grain or gradient. The eye hole, beak channel, and curved wing separation must now reveal this same white tile.
Refine the blue parrot fill to a slightly deeper, clearly legible yet moderately muted blue, target #3F719B. Make the bird conspicuous on white by luminance contrast and solid clean edges, with restrained saturation. No neon, cyan, turquoise, electric blue, excessive chroma, washed-out pastel or nearly black navy. Keep the bird flat and uniform with no texture or shading.
Preserve the exact silhouette, round crown, circular eye, strongly hooked upper beak, small separate lower-beak island, curved negative-space wing line, proportions, position, size, tile dimensions and corner curvature. Do not redraw, simplify or enlarge the bird. Keep real transparent alpha ONLY outside the rounded-square tile, cleanly antialiased with no stray flecks or noise. The tile interior must remain opaque white. No outline, border, glow, shadow, extra shapes, text, watermark, comparison layout or mockup. Output one square clean production icon.
appIcon.processing: Generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; existing exporter handles alpha cleanup, trim and native resizing only.
